reason: My broker already buys the same index funds for me every month for free, and I barely look at it, which is how I like it. I'm not handing real money to an AI pet from an app I just met, with a broker partner that doesn't even exist yet.
objection: I don't trust an AI with my money. Limits and a stop switch are nice, but if it does something dumb I'm the one who eats the loss, and I can't tell who's actually holding my money.
would_change_my_mind: A big, known licensed broker actually holding the account with SIPC protection, plus a year of other people's real-money track record showing it doesn't do anything my plain monthly autopilot wouldn't.
